title: Tool / Automation Authority
purpose: Governs enterprise toolchains, software versions, approved plugins, automation scripts, and digital interfaces (links to S9). Approves automated changes, API tools, and platform integrations to ensure information integrity and toolchain security.
authority_statements: Approve automated changes, script execution permissions, and tool governance across projects
Approve software version deployments, service pack baselines, and add-ins
Authorize toolchain interoperability protocols and data exchange schemas
Reject unvalidated automation tools or unapproved plugins that risk data integrity
responsibilities: Maintain enterprise catalog of approved BIM authoring, coordination, and validation tools
Test and validate automation scripts and plugins prior to project deployment
Define standard export/import configuration settings for authorized tools
Monitor tool performance, software bugs, and vendor patches across the organization
accountabilities: Integrity, stability, and security of governed digital toolchains and automations
Alignment of software toolchains with TIVERIT BIM Standards
approvals: Approved software versions and add-ins list
Automated scripts and batch routines deployed to production
inputs: Tool adoption and automation requests from project teams
Vendor release notes and security bulletins
Technical requirements from BIM Director and BIM Detailer

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.
